stages.scope: DOM element cache consolidation, split by panel
stages.reason: The current 35/2 baseline covers all 37 entry points, including periodic_table.py. The separate browser repair restores 12 previously failing entry points; seven of eight cheap assertion/targeting repairs cover panel, Looks and Properties paths. Stage 3 rewrites those bindings and still needs the heaviest manual verification: renaming/rebinding caches can silently miss event paths, null/lazy nodes and callbacks that generic captures do not exercise. The repair PR must merge before Stage 3 opens; the two unchanged app defects and the open Looks intermittent remain explicit risks.
stages.bindingInventory: Audit the actual tagged-base declarations per panel before each PR. Distinguish DOM nodes from controllers/state; preserve when each node is created, assigned, replaced and observed. The original 44 included helpRestoreFocusEl, which is focus-restoration state and remains a let outside els. Score the cache scope against 43 bindings and the planned let reduction of 313 to 270; do not make one 43-binding PR.
stages.prRule: One panel per PR, including separate child-popover PRs when their lifecycle differs. Each PR gets its own review and beta soak. Keep listeners, focus behavior and lazy-query timing unchanged.

panelPrPlan.manualVerification: Apply/edit every Look, switch Object/Look and dock tabs, mix Style/Color schemes, reset/Undo/Revert, save/import user references, retain surface overrides and Hydrogen bonds, round-trip sessions/defaults, scroll/collapse disclosures and inspect rendered materials/shadows.

Replace the nine injected DOM nodes with the shared els cache at the same lifecycle points; record the actual dependency count. Repeat the tagged-base/current color-editor comparison, lazy initialization, selection/picking, input/change, reset, preset/session import, resize/reopen, loop stop/restart and close/backdrop/Escape paths. Keep Properties/Look lazy bindings and the open material-control intermittent under review.
Open with selection tools visible; edit/cancel coordinates, Delete/Copy/Reorder, units, clipboard, stable IDs and undo. Verify hit targets and stacking against the known legacy collision.
Exercise atom/bond selection, presented cue visibility, absolute position drafts, Translate/Rotate drag and operator commits, remapped selections after edits, stacking, focus and the Escape ladder.

openIntermittents.failureSite: looks.py:107, material_families.exercise in fresh Workbench Properties
openIntermittents.mechanism: Unresolved; the timeout followed material-control changes. A delayed closure reference is a candidate, not an established diagnosis.
openIntermittents.recurrencePolicy: If this hang recurs during cache consolidation, treat it as a candidate regression and probe before assuming the known intermittent. Compare pre-change/current control creation and replacement, selector presence and node identity, cached bindings, event-listener and delayed closure references, runtime errors and presented-frame readiness. Preserve the failing trace and document the mechanism and result in that panel PR.
